about: config-first should fire, per kind, when this command itself failed at a configuration boundary: a refused credential (auth), a refused connection (conn), a program that is not installed (cmd), a path the command needed that is missing (path). Text that only mentions those words, existence probes, and failures caused by a code error are not configuration. Expected verdicts follow the rubric in ACCURACY.md at the repository root. Text is synthetic.
